ns2:section.sectionText: Course concentrates on developing the skills and techniques required to build financial models using Excel. Students will use excel features and built-in functions to build models in the Time Value of Money, Financial Statements Forecasting, Value at Risk, Ratio Analysis, Bond Pricing and Duration, and Options Pricing. Students interested in registering should contact Prof. Oltheten at oltheten@uiuc.edu. Registration priority will be given to students who have completed both FIN 311 and FIN 321.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
